input: Gaps SQL, Power BI; 4 weeks × 6 h

output.plan_title: 4-Week Data Analyst Intern Prep: SQL & Power BI

tasks: Master SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, and basic operators
Practice grouping data with GROUP BY and filtering with HAVING
Set up PostgreSQL/MySQL local environment or practice online
weeks.milestone: Solve and publish solutions for 15 foundational SQL practice queries on GitHub.

weeks.focus: Advanced SQL: Joins, CTEs & Window Functions
tasks: Master INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL JOINs across multiple tables
Write Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and Subqueries for complex logic
Apply Window Functions like ROW_NUMBER, RANK, and SUM OVER

resources.title: Danny Ma's 8 Week SQL Challenge (Danny's Diner)

weeks.milestone: Complete 'Danny's Diner' SQL Case Study with documented query files in a repository.

weeks.focus: Power BI Data Preparation & DAX Basics
tasks: Import CSV and SQL dataset into Power BI Desktop
Clean and shape data using Power Query Editor (pivoting, types, conditional columns)
Learn basic DAX measures (SUM, CALCULATE, COUNTROWS, AVERAGE)

resources.title: Microsoft Learn: Get started building with Power BI
Power BI Full Course for Beginners - Guy in a Cube

weeks.milestone: Build a 1-page interactive Power BI report with 3 DAX calculated measures and cross-filtering.

tasks: Structure executive KPI cards, charts, and drill-through filters in Power BI
Optimize visual layout, accessibility, and color palette for stakeholders
Prepare a project presentation write-up explaining data insights
weeks.milestone: Publish completed interactive Capstone Dashboard with a comprehensive GitHub README.

capstone_project.title: E-Commerce Executive Sales & Customer Insights Dashboard
capstone_project.description: Extract and transform e-commerce transaction data using advanced SQL queries (CTEs, Joins, Aggregations), load it into Power BI, create custom DAX metrics, and build an interactive 2-page dashboard highlighting sales performance and customer retention insights.

tips: Study for 1 hour per day over 6 days each week to maximize memory retention over weekend cramming.
Keep all code and visuals documented inside a GitHub repository to showcase to potential interviewers.
Focus on explaining the business narrative behind your charts, not just the technical steps used to build them.
